newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar extends losses in evening.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar extends losses in evening.

text.p: London white sugar futures deepened their losses by the close on Friday evening, after being pressured by a weaker raws market in New York.
Front month May ended $2.30 lower at $310.90 per tonne, just 20 cents off the low, ahead of the contract's expiry next week.
Less demand for EU sugars should limit physical delivery against May whites and the chance of a squeeze on short positions, traders said.
August closed $1.70 softer at $310.00, also near its low.
Volume was sizeable at 4,045 lots, fuelled by crosses and against actuals trades. The two front months dominated the day, with May responsible for 1,868 lots and August for 1,748 lots.
In Paris, May finished $2.30 down at $312.20 and August $1.50 weaker at $310.50.
